g.text: Afterwards the gateway, start-controller.sh, start-workers-container.sh and funnel.sh read gateway.env at
their next start, line by line, never executed. The environment and controller/.mcp.json win.
Model and effort: --model and --effort for the controller and for every worker run, also in Docker.
Orange: cloud service · purple: own code · blue: Docker · grey: your browser and files · yellow: notes
